headline: AI for Indigenous language revitalization; Prairie adoption
digest: SFU's FLAIR project (First Languages AI Reality, named in the national strategy) is building AI learning modules and speech tools with the Gwich'in, Kwakwaka'wakw, Makah and Yawanawá. Amii and PrairiesCan expanded an AI adoption program, and Digital Moment published the principles behind its AI Literacy Framework.
